offers.sn: About the job: The Electrical Engineer (LV & MV) supports the design, implementation, and operation of electrical systems that power our large-scale data centers.
offers.rq: Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field. 3–6 years of relevant experience in electrical design, construction, or maintenance, ideally in data centers, industrial, or energy infrastructure environments. Familiarity with IEC standards and Portuguese electrical regulations. Strong command of English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
